title: Owner Auto Policy Rating Bulletin: Ride-Hailing and Delivery Use When a Resident Is Listed Again
content:
**Platform-use relativity on re-listing.** Under the company's filed driver rating, a platform-use relativity multiplies the share of a household resident listed again on the Owner Auto Policy. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent.

The relativity counts claim reports of the term on the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) claim file. A report counts when it names the resident as operator while an unlisted household resident, with the vehicle in use on a ride-hailing or delivery platform.

| Such claim reports | Relativity |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.3 |
| one | 1.15 |
| none | 1 |

**Hypothetical reading.** Of two unlisted-operator reports naming the resident, only one records platform use, so the relativity is 1.15.
